rule: A reserved trigger fires only when the complete trimmed user message equals one registered trigger word. Never trigger on ordinary prose containing the word.
mesh_rule: All scientific trigger branches are interdependent research views of one RAE. Every run must ingest all connected branches before Fusion 1, including newer in-progress branch material, preserve evidence ancestry, scan contradictions and write cross-links back to affected branches. FRANK↔ClayCode agreement must pass the Goodman anti-echo filter before it can count as support. ClayGraph covers associative memory/knowledge-graph/database-migration research; UnifiedDB covers the broader logically unified persistence/query/transaction substrate and must preserve explicit semantic-vs-physical separation. Clay permanently includes Safe-Effect Geometry / Non-Damaging Semantic Action Space as a mandatory falsifiable research axis; the research requirement is fixed but the claimed safety/alignment benefits are not pre-promoted as true. The fusion meta-trigger researches across the complete mesh and must return an explicit feedback receipt to every scientific branch. The hypofusion meta-trigger additionally screens all reachable current/open hypotheses against broad external supporting, analogous, better-mechanism and counterhypothesis evidence, rereads live workers before final fusion, and returns discriminating tests plus branch feedback.

dump.purpose: Ingest arbitrary dump material, fuse it with current RAE knowledge, research derived hypotheses, packetize results, then archive the processed originals.

fusion.purpose: Research across the complete current RAE knowledge/evidence graph, generate cross-domain hypotheses and experiments, resolve or expose contradictions, and write explicit feedback deltas or NO_CHANGE receipts back to every scientific branch.

hypofusion.purpose: Screen all reachable current/open RAE hypotheses, including fresh in-progress worker material, against broad external supporting, analogous, better-mechanism, null, failure-mode and counterhypothesis evidence across scholarly literature, arXiv, GitHub, authoritative technical sources, broad web indexes, practitioner sources and bridge publications, then generate discriminating tests and execute a whole-mesh Fusion 2 with feedback to every scientific branch.

clay.purpose: Run the complete Synthetic Clay recursive research foundry across GWT, FRANK architecture, emergence measurement, ClayCode/4B internal language, hyperposition/codependency, ClayGraph associative memory, UnifiedDB persistence/query/transaction substrate, low-latency emergent software and the permanent Safe-Effect Geometry / Non-Damaging Semantic Action Space research axis.

gwt.purpose: Research Global Workspace mechanisms in AI systems: selection, competition, ignition, broadcast, reconstruction, effect, re-entry, multi-timescale coupling and causal validation.

frank.purpose: Research FRANK as one integrated cognitive/runtime architecture grounded primarily in newest Synthetic Clay research, authored as ClayCode semantic IR, and informed by ClayGraph memory plus UnifiedDB persistence/query substrate research.

emergenz.purpose: Research and measure emergence using GWT-linked causal interventions, lesion/rescue, re-entry, interaction terms, PID/PEID/transfer entropy and multiscale causal tests.

claycode.purpose: Research ClayCode as FRANK's internal architecture/runtime language and Synthetic Clay semantic IR, using newest FRANK research as primary target feedback and independently verifying/refining/refuting FRANK-derived assumptions through the Goodman anti-echo filter.

hyperposition.purpose: Research emergent systems, contextual hyperposition, higher-order codependencies, dynamic topology and near-zero-latency software via shared/incremental state. 'Entanglement' is an engineering analogy unless physical quantum effects are actually tested.

claygraph.purpose: Research the XENO/Synthetic-Clay associative knowledge graph, persistent cognitive memory substrate and evidence-driven reversible migration/transcendence of FRANK graph/state stores, while exchanging substrate constraints with UnifiedDB.

unifieddb.purpose: Research FRANK's Unified Database / Unified Cognitive Data Substrate: one logically unified Clay-native semantic identity, persistence, query, transaction and retrieval plane across exact state/events, temporal/provenance data, graph memory, vectors, FTS, activation, Assemblies/GWT and effect/outcome state, with physical consolidation only when benchmark-justified.
